name: kwin-mcp
description: Use a configured KWin MCP server for isolated KDE desktop work.

interface.shortDescription: KDE Plasma 6 Wayland GUI automation over MCP
interface.longDescription: The included skill helps Codex choose between a configured KWin MCP session and the user's current desktop, and verify GUI work without disturbing the user's windows. Configure the MCP server separately.
defaultPrompt: Use KWin MCP to inspect this desktop app without moving my windows.
